john.15.p1.b1.text: “I am the true vine, and My Father is the keeper of the vineyard.

john.15.p1.b2.text: He cuts off every branch in Me that bears no fruit, and every branch that does bear fruit, He prunes to make it even more fruitful.

john.15.p2.b1.text: Remain in Me, and I will remain in you.

john.15.p2.b2.text: I am the vine and you are the branches.

john.15.p2.b3.text: … For apart from Me you can do nothing.

john.15.p2.b4.text: If anyone does not remain in Me, he is like a branch that is thrown away and withers. Such branches are gathered up, thrown into the fire, and burned.

john.15.p3.b1.text: If you remain in Me and My words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.

john.15.p3.b2.text: This is to My Father’s glory, that you bear much fruit, proving yourselves to be My disciples.

john.15.p3.b3.text: As the Father has loved Me, so have I loved you. Remain in My love.

john.15.p4.b1.text: I have told you these things so that My joy may be in you and your joy may be complete.

john.15.p4.b2.text: This is My commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.

john.15.p4.b3.text: Greater love has no one than this, that he lay down his life for his friends.

john.15.p5.b1.text: You are My friends if you do what I command you.

john.15.p5.b2.text: No longer do I call you servants, … But I have called you friends, because everything I have learned from My Father I have made known to you.

john.15.p5.b3.text: for a servant does not understand what his master is doing.

john.15.p6.b1.text: You did not choose Me, but I chose you.

john.15.p6.b2.text: And I appointed you to go and bear fruit—fruit that will remain—

john.15.p6.b3.text: This is My command to you: Love one another.

john.15.p7.b2.text: If the world hates you, understand that it hated Me first.

john.15.p7.b3.text: … because you are not of the world, but I have chosen you out of the world.

john.15.p8.b1.text: Remember the word that I spoke to you: ‘No servant is greater than his master.’

john.15.p8.b2.text: If they persecuted Me, they will persecute you as well;

john.15.p8.b3.text: Now, however, they have no excuse for their sin.

john.15.p9.b1.text: Whoever hates Me hates My Father as well.

john.15.p9.b2.text: but now they have seen and hated both Me and My Father.

john.15.p9.b3.text: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated Me without reason.’

john.15.p10.b1.text: When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who proceeds from the Father—

john.15.p10.b3.text: And you also must testify, because you have been with Me from the beginning.
